nodes.label: Classroom Selector Pill
nodes.rationale: A dropdown pill reading '2학년 2반 본관 2층', shown under the AirClass logo and the notification bell.

nodes.label: CO2 High State (Orange Hero)
nodes.rationale: CO2 1,180 over the 1,000ppm limit and outside air is fine, so the app tells people to ventilate ('환기가 필요해요', rule 2).

nodes.label: Floating Rounded Tab Bar
nodes.rationale: Four tabs (홈, 제어, 예측·알림, 설정) in a floating rounded bar; the selected tab gets a light-blue background.

nodes.label: Forecast Pre-Ventilation Banner
nodes.rationale: A partly hidden banner in the CO2 state: '2시간 뒤 실외 미세먼지가 나빠질 예정이라 지금이 환…'. This is ML rule 4, which is out of scope, so it should be dummy data or marked as a future extension.

nodes.label: Metric Cards 2x2
nodes.rationale: Four cards (CO2, PM2.5, temperature, humidity). Each has an icon, a status badge (양호/환기 필요), a tabular number, a progress bar with a threshold tick, and the limit text (기준 1,000ppm, 35㎍/㎥, 적정 18~26°C, 40~60%).

nodes.label: Normal State (Blue Hero)
nodes.rationale: CO2 620, outside PM2.5 18. Headline '공기가 깨끗해요'; air purifier on power-saving standby (rule 5).

nodes.label: Outdoor Bad State (Navy Hero)
nodes.rationale: CO2 1,080 and outside PM2.5 58 (bad), so ventilation is limited: keep windows closed and run the air purifier (rule 3).

nodes.label: Window Illustration with CO2/PM2.5
nodes.rationale: A central window icon shows the status (check mark = ok, arrows = open to ventilate, no-entry sign = keep closed). Indoor CO2 sits on the left and outdoor PM2.5 on the right, each with a status chip.

nodes.label: App Home 3-State Slide
nodes.rationale: Side-by-side mockups of the mobile app home screen in its three status states, used as a one-glance design reference.

nodes.label: Status-Colored Hero
nodes.rationale: The hero background color shows the status at a glance (blue, orange or navy). It includes a status badge, a headline and two lines of '~해요' guidance.

nodes.rationale: Cards show value vs 기준 (35 / 1,000) and the automatic action taken (공기청정기 자동 가동, 담임 환기 알림), so admins see why each room is flagged and what the system already did.

nodes.label: 24-Hour Trend Chart (CO2/PM2.5 tabs)
nodes.rationale: Area line chart from 어제 10시 to 지금; CO2 peaks during class hours, drops overnight, rises again to exceed threshold now. Shaded 수업 시간 band and dashed 환기 필요 1,000ppm threshold line. Segmented toggle switches metric.

nodes.label: Applied Control Rules Log (적용된 제어 규칙)
nodes.norm_label: applied control rules log (적용된 제어 규칙)
nodes.rationale: Numbered rule entries: 2 (CO2 high + outdoor good -> ventilation recommend), 4 (predicted outdoor bad in 2h -> pre-ventilation), 5 (all normal -> standby). Rule 4 is out of scope per CLAUDE.md, so implementation must mark it as future extension or omit.

nodes.label: Web Room Detail Screen (교실 상세)
nodes.rationale: Admin drill-down for one classroom (2학년 2반, 본관 2층) reached from 교실별 모니터링; back link returns to room list. Combines live readings, 24h trend, device history and applied rules so admins see why automation acted.

nodes.label: AirClass README
nodes.rationale: Classrooms accumulate CO2 quickly, but opening windows on bad outdoor-dust days worsens air; so indoor and outdoor values are judged together.

nodes.label: Single Data Access File (api.js)
nodes.rationale: All data goes through web/src/api.js and app/src/api.js so dummy data can later be swapped for the Raspberry Pi FastAPI backend by changing one file.

nodes.label: No Automatic Window Control
nodes.rationale: Ventilation is only guided to humans via notifications; windows are never opened/closed automatically.

nodes.label: shared/ Data + Rules Import Policy
nodes.rationale: Data and judgment logic must be imported from shared/; no hardcoding in web or app, so both share identical rules.
